       black,
       whiteElo,

submitted_query:
WITH latest_dept AS (
 SELECT d.emp_no, d.dept_no
 FROM employee.dept_emp d
 JOIN (
   SELECT emp_no, MAX(to_date) AS max_to
   FROM employee.dept_emp
   GROUP BY emp_no
 ) m ON d.emp_no = m.emp_no AND d.to_date = m.max_to
),
latest_title AS (
 SELECT t.emp_no, t.title
 FROM employee.titles t
 JOIN (
   SELECT emp_no, MAX(to_date) AS max_to
   FROM employee.titles
   GROUP BY emp_no
 ) m ON t.emp_no = m.emp_no AND t.to_date = m.max_to
),
current_salaries AS (
 SELECT s.emp_no, s.salary
 FROM employee.salaries s
 WHERE s.to_date = DATE '9999-01-01'
),
emp_data AS (
 SELECT e.emp_no, e.gender, e.hire_date,
        d.dept_no, t.title, s.salary,
        DATE_DIFF('year', e.hire_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS tenure_years

),

WITH filtered AS (

        CASE
            WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'Essential'
            WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'Discretionary'

        END AS spending_type,
        c.charge_amt,
        c.charge_code
    FROM Credit.charge AS c
    WHERE c.charge_amt <> 0.01               -- exclude test transactions

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE charge_code <> 'RF') AS charge_count,

FROM filtered

ORDER BY spending_type;
